effect_description_eng: [When Digivolving] 1 of your opponent's Digimon gains ＜Security A. -2＞ (This Digimon checks 2 additional security cards.) until the end of their turn.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [When Attacking] If you have 3 or fewer security cards, you may play 1 yellow level 3 Digimon card from your hand without paying the cost.
